paper.title: EvoAgentX: An Automated Framework for Evolving Agentic Workflows
paper.central_claim: EvoAgentX, an open-source five-layer platform that automates generation, execution and evolutionary optimization of multi-agent workflows by integrating TextGrad, AFlow and MIPRO, consistently improves performance on HotPotQA, MBPP, MATH and GAIA.

gap.author_gap: Multi-agent systems need manual workflow construction and lack native support for dynamic evolution; optimization algorithms (TextGrad, AFlow, MIPRO) are fragmented and not integrated into one platform.
gap.checked_gap: Real engineering gap, but not shown to be a performance bottleneck: the paper never tests whether integration changes outcomes or compares against using the optimizers directly or against existing toolkits.
